description: Customers report accounts that are lost, inaccessible, locked, or apparently hacked. Some also say they cannot use the app in certain countries or while traveling.
code_definition: account hacked, banned, deleted, lost or stuck in the wrong country/profile

description: Customers report being unable to log in or create an account, including trouble receiving an OTP or finding a password-change option. One customer also says the desktop scanner option for mobile login is unavailable.
code_definition: cannot log in or sign up; password, verification or 'logged out' problems

description: Customers report being charged for subscriptions, difficulty completing payments, and delays before Premium access appears after purchase. Some also say a package purchase is not shown.
code_definition: wrong or repeated charges, refunds, payment failures, Premium not activating after paying

description: Customers say choosing or replaying specific parts of songs, skipping, shuffling, repeating, lyrics, and better audio quality are limited or require Premium. Some also report frequent prompts to subscribe.
code_definition: a feature is locked behind Premium or limited on the free tier (choosing a song, skips, rewind, repeat, turning shuffle off), or the app pressures users to buy Premium

description: Customers say premium subscriptions and plans feel expensive, and some object to price increases or having to pay to use Spotify.
code_definition: price, price increases, plans, value for money

description: Customers say their liked songs or saved music are missing, playlists appear empty, or their liked playlist will not load.
code_definition: praise for how much or what kind of music/podcasts is available ("has every song", "huge selection"); not for "great music" in general

description: Customers say lyrics are missing or unavailable for some songs, and one reports that lyrics are incorrect.
code_definition: lyrics missing, wrong or unavailable

issue_name: Songs and podcasts are missing or unavailable
description: Customers say songs are missing from playlists or unavailable in search, and some cannot find particular audiobooks or podcasts. One customer also says podcast videos are not visible.
code_definition: songs, artists, podcasts, videos or languages missing, removed or unavailable

description: Customers report receiving recommended or suggested songs they dislike, including songs added to playlists or played during shuffle. Some also say recommendations repeat or include artists they have blocked.
code_definition: recommendations, discovery, search, generated mixes, unwanted suggested songs

description: Customers say they cannot download music or play downloaded songs while offline. Some also report that downloads are unavailable to them.
code_definition: downloads fail, disappear or will not play offline

description: Customers express political, religious, or ethical objections to Spotify, including objections related to its country of origin, advertising, or artist compensation. Some say they are deleting or want to ban the app.
code_definition: political, religious, ethical or boycott statements that are not about how the product works

description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, calling it bad, annoying, or disappointing. Some specifically say it felt worse after an update.
code_definition: general praise or criticism with no specific feature

description: One sampled review contains hard-to-interpret wording that does not clearly describe a Spotify issue.
code_definition: meaningless, unrelated or unintelligible text

description: Customers report low or poor audio quality, missing high-resolution or Dolby audio options, and limited or resetting equalizer settings. Some also say playback volume is too loud or there is no sound.
code_definition: sound quality or volume problems

issue_name: Playback connection and device switching issues
description: Customers report offline or no-internet messages despite having internet access, along with problems playing or controlling music through a car or watch and switching between devices.
code_definition: 'no internet connection' errors, or playback via bluetooth, car, cast, speaker, watch, another device or a voice assistant

issue_name: App Crashes, Freezes, or Fails to Load
description: Customers report crashes during playback, hangs or unresponsiveness, and problems opening or loading the app. One says they frequently have to reinstall it to get it working.
code_definition: app crashes, freezes, will not open or is stuck loading

description: Customers report that the app feels laggy or runs poorly, and that pages and songs can take a long time to load or play. One customer also says the app uses a lot of mobile data.
code_definition: lag, slowness, battery, storage or mobile-data use

issue_name: Playback Stops or Fails to Start
description: Customers say music sometimes will not play or stops and pauses during a song. Some also report that playback does not continue to the next song.
code_definition: music or podcasts will not play, stop, pause, buffer, skip or restart by themselves

description: Customers report difficulty finding support, unanswered messages, and feeling ignored or poorly supported. One says a representative cancelled their subscription without notice; another says cancelling is difficult.
code_definition: contacting customer support and the response received

description: Customers report that ads are too frequent or too long, including ads appearing after a few songs or interrupting access to music.
code_definition: too many, too long, too loud or badly timed ads

description: Customers report unwanted shuffle behavior, inability to select or rearrange songs, and problems with rewind, forward, and playback order. One also says Spotify continues to think they are in a car after they get home.
code_definition: shuffle, skip, repeat, queue, playlist editing, autoplay or voice controls that work badly, NOT described as a Premium-only restriction

description: Customers report that the new interface can lag while scrolling and take up screen space with moving content. Some say they can no longer find settings or lists, use player controls, or access features they previously had.
code_definition: layout, navigation, redesigns, home screen, notifications, widgets, removed interface features
